subject: Next steps: deployment path recommendation & PoC owners
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@finedge.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finedge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: deployment path recommendation & next steps

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation. Recap and recommended next steps below. Please confirm anything I missed.

Short summary of what we heard
- Primary driver: data residency + strict audit trail requirements for model inputs/outputs (security/compliance).
- Primary workload: customer-facing support automation (chat + short generations) with occasional large-batch embeddings for search refreshes.
- Desired SLO: 95th perc latency <200ms for chat RTT and embedding throughput of ~300qps during nightly windows.

Recommended deployment path (our read)
- Private (VPC) deployment looks like the best fit given compliance & audit log needs. Dedicated capacity would be second-best if you prefer managed isolation without full private control; Hosted API is least likely due to residency constraints.

Proposed PoC approach (high-level)
1) Kickoff & scoping (this week): confirm data flow diagram and legal POC guardrails.
2) Security & infra intake (1 week): exchange questionnaire + identify firewall/VPN/peering requirements.
3) Proof-of-concept (3 weeks): deploy Private control plane into your VPC, run chat workload at representative traffic, validate audit logs and KMS integration.
4) Evaluation & decision (1 week): validate success criteria below and agree next steps.

Proposed PoC success criteria
- Audit log completeness: every request/response mapped to a trace id and retained per your retention policy.
- Performance: 95th perc chat RTT <200ms under representative load, embedding batch throughput >250qps during night window.
- Security: KMS integration for key management and no external network egress for customer payloads.
- Cost/ops: Demonstrated autoscaling from idle to target throughput with predictable unit economics (cost per 1k tokens).

Immediate asks from FinEdge
- Can you confirm the internal technical contact and the infra team who will own VPC setup?
- Any restrictions on timeline (e.g., change freeze windows) we should be aware of?

Attached: redwood-poc-runbook-v1.xlsx (PoC steps / owner matrix), security-sample-scope.pdf

Thanks — I’ve looped Ben (solutions) on next technical steps. I’ll update the runbook after your feedback.

—
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0124
From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@finedge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finedge.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: deployment path recommendation & next steps

Evelyn — thanks for the thorough summary. Confirming a few things from our side: we are strongly leaning toward Private (VPC) because of the regulator asking for isolation and auditability. A couple of clarifications:

- The audit log requirement: must be immutable and retained for 7 years. Can Redwood guarantee write-once storage or provide a ledger-style evidence export?
- KMS: we use an internal AWS KMS with custom key policies; need to ensure Redwood’s control plane can integrate without key material leaving our account.
- Timeline: we have a freeze from Jun 15–22 (end of quarter systems validation).

Technical contacts: Priya Shah (Cloud/Infra lead) <priya.shah@finedge.com> and Raj Mehta (Security) — I’ll introduce Raj in a separate thread.

Thanks — Tom
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@finedge.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finedge.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: deployment path recommendation & next steps

Tom/Priya — great to meet you (virtually). Short answers to the items you flagged plus action items: 

- Audit logs: Redwood can stream audit logs to your S3 bucket with object immutability enabled (we support S3 Object Lock compliance mode). We can also provide periodic signed evidence bundles if you require ledger-style attestations.
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys via cross-account grants; the control plane never extracts key material. We’ll need an IAM role and a minimal set of permissions.
- Freeze window: noted — we’ll target PoC kickoff week of Jun 22 to avoid your freeze.

Action items
- Priya: provide the VPC ID, peering/VPN constraints, and an IAM contact for the KMS role (target: Jun 11).
- Tom: confirm Raj Mehta’s email so we can add him to the security intake (Tom said he’d introduce Raj separately).
- Evelyn/Ben: we’ll produce an updated runbook reflecting the KMS/IAM steps and object-lock configuration by Jun 12.

I’ve attached a short technical appendix to the runbook (see redwood-poc-runbook-v1.xlsx sheet "infra-steps"). Happy to run a 30-min tech session after we receive Priya’s infra notes.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0199
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: deployment path recommendation & PoC owners

Thanks Tom — appreciate the clarity. Looping Marissa from our customer success team so she can track runbook updates and coordinate the evaluation checklist during the PoC. 

Confirmed PoC plan and owners
- Redwood: Evelyn (AE, engagement lead), Ben (SE, technical lead), Marissa (CS, evaluation & ops contact).
- FinEdge: Tom (Executive sponsor), Priya (Infra lead), Raj Mehta (Security) — please add Raj when convenient.

Updated timeline (accounting for your freeze)
- Jun 11: Priya provides VPC/KMS/IAM notes (action: FinEdge)
- Jun 12: Redwood sends updated runbook + tech appendix (action: Ben)
- Week of Jun 22: PoC kickoff and infra provisioning (action: joint)
- Weeks of Jun 22–Jul 12: PoC execution and data collection
- Jul 13: Joint evaluation meeting and decision

Success criteria (short list for acceptance)
- Audit log delivery to customer S3 with Object Lock enabled; verified exports for three representative sessions.
- 95th perc chat RTT <200ms at 80% of target concurrency (we’ll define exact concurrency in the kickoff).
- KMS integration validated with cross-account grant; no key material leaves FinEdge account.
- Acceptance sign-off from Raj (Security) and Priya (Infra).

Next steps (what I need from you)
1) Priya: VPC ID, peering/VPN constraints, AWS account id for KMS role by Jun 11.
2) Tom: intro to Raj so we can include security intake questionnaire.
3) Everyone: review attached runbook and call out gaps by EOD Jun 12.

I’ll open the HubSpot deal record and share the runbook link (see related_links). Happy to jump on a 20-min sync if that helps unblock Priya.

Best —
Evelyn
